messages:
taylor: Heads up — kb link scan flagged a 404 in /docs/runtime/optimization. The anchor for 'batching best practices' is missing, anyone own that page? cc @maria

dev-bot: scan-report: /docs/runtime/optimization#batching-best-practices -> 404 (scan id: kb-scan-202803). Seen in last crawl.

alex: IIRC that page got a heading shuffle in the last refactor, likely the anchor changed. Last author was @sam on a small refactor PR.

maria: I can take this. Quick q: should we restore the old anchor (add an h3) or point the broken links to the new slug? Restoring could be fragile if we change headings again.

sam: i'd prefer update the links to the canonical slug instead of reintroducing orphan anchors. less brittle. If you open a tiny PR i will review quickly. Example search to find bad links: `git grep -n "runtime/optimization#batching" || true`

taylor: here's the failing URL from the crawler logs: ```https://kb.redwood.com/docs/runtime/optimization#batching-best-practices```

taylor: also noticed the page has an image that's 403ing: `/assets/diagrams/diagram-2.png` — might need rehost to CDN.

sam: :thumbsup: i can rehost diagram-2.png if you include the new path in the PR, otherwise i can follow up after the link fix.

maria: ok working on a tiny PR now — will update internal links to the new slug and swap the image src to the CDN path. ETA ~2h. pinging @alex @sam for review.

deploy-bot: docs-preview build started for PR (preview id 9876) — https://ci.redwood.com/builds/9876

maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 — includes sed-based link updates and image rehost. sha: abc123. PTAL.

alex: skimmed — LGTM overall, left one tiny nit about alt text for the rehosted image.

sam: approved. quick follow-up: can we add a short redirect entry for old anchors to avoid noisy 404s in the next scan? not required but helpful.

maria: added a small redirect rule in the PR (docs/redirects.yaml). will merge after CI green.

taylor: thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround :sparkles:

(dev-bot reaction: :white_check_mark: scan resolved on next crawl)
